items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
FACTORIO CRASH-SITE SCENARIO – PROGRESS NOTES

OBJECTIVE (observed): Tutorial panel top-right tracks 'Steam power'. Hovering it showed text 'Craft 50 Iron plate' (progress 0/4 shown; bar rose 18%→30% as plates were produced). Iron plate count reached 10 at last check; ~40 more needed. Press T opens research screen: Electronics available but requires 10 red science packs (would need copper).

VERIFIED CONTROLS (observed, reliable):
- WASD = move; M = map/remote view (WASD in map view pans camera, not player); T = research; E = inventory/crafting; Esc = game menu; Q = clear cursor item; R = rotate (says 'This cannot be rotated' on drills); F = pick up nearby ground items; J = HOLD to hand-mine ore/stone/trees (pickaxe animation, +1 per completion, floating '+1 Iron ore (n)' text); selection of middle quickbar by number keys.
- Ctrl+click = quick transfer into/out of building GUIs (works for inserting stack into furnace/drill input and taking result). Hover first, then issue a stationary click (clicks often execute at the previous pointer position).
- Mining a placed building with J returns it (and contents) to inventory (observed: '+4 Wood' + drill back after mining a drill).

PLACEMENT MECHANICS (observed):
- Build ghost color: red = out of reach/invalid; yellow/green = valid. Ghost follows cursor; placed entities can later render invisible or appear only after ticks.
- Silent failure cause identified once: red message 'Character is in the way' when 2x2 ghost overlaps player tile.
- Most reliable placement: pick item (from inventory or quickbar), hover target 1-2 tiles from player clear of his tile so ghost is yellow/green, then stationary click. Many attempts still fail silently; retry different tiles.
- Some placements did succeed (drill ×3-4, furnace ×1); inventory checks (E) are the only reliable confirmation.

LOCATIONS (observed):
- Player started near crashed ship; walked east/southeast into a large iron ore field (per-tile amounts 30-700+).
- Map: copper (orange checkers) north; stone (tan) south/southwest of iron field; biter nests (red) far east; lake southwest.
- Trees for wood: north of the iron field (chopping gives ~4 wood per tree). Stone patch visited: amounts 200-800+/tile.
- Placed stone furnace (fuelled, recipe Iron plate set, 'No ingredients'/idle) is near the center of the iron field, roughly at/south of the player's current spot. At least one burner drill was placed near the furnace; another existed earlier (fueled with wood x4, later 'Target full', later mined back).

INVENTORY (approximate, last known): drill x1 (often held as ghost), stone x1-8, iron plates ~10, wood 0-4, iron ore 0-6, sometimes extra stone x4.

FAILED / UNPRODUCTIVE STRATEGIES:
- Repeated right/left clicks on placed drill near ore did not open GUI until literally adjacent (two clicks sometimes needed; GUI opens reliably once within ~2 tiles).
- Clicking 'Start research' does nothing (needs red science).
- Clicking ore/drill ghost spots on the character's own tile fails (overlap).
- Stone inserted into fuel slot → error 'Stone cannot be used as fuel.' Clear cursor first (Q) before fueling; must pick wood deliberately (tooltip check) to avoid inserting stone.
- Trees/bushes clicks do nothing; only J hold mines.
- Placed buildings may render invisible; hovering exact center sometimes gives no tooltip — rely on inventory counts and side-panel data.

WORKING LOOP (latest):
1) Hand-mine iron ore with J (hover adjacent ore first; cursor too far gives 'Cannot reach').
2) Walk to fuelled furnace, click it (twice if needed) to open GUI.
3) Ctrl+click held iron ore stack (e.g., slot 2 tooltip 'Iron ore') into furnace → recipe 'Iron plate' begins, 'Working', progress %.
4) Wait ~2s cycles; hover result slot (right of progress bar, ~0.734,0.539) then stationary ctrl+click to collect plates.
Furnace fuel: wood x3 inserted (each ~4 MJ burn), 'Max consumption 90 kW'.

UNRESOLVED / UNCERTAIN:
- Why some valid yellow placements still fail (guesses: click-position lag, occupied tiles by invisible drills, reaching limits).
- Whether extra drills remain in inventory vs placed; whether the objective counts crafted-vs-carried plates ('Craft 50' suggests cumulative crafting).
- Boiler/steam engine recipes not yet located (Production tab shows only drill/furnace craftable); offshore pump would need the SW lake. Whether scenario requires actually building steam machinery or just 50 plates is unconfirmed.
- Copper patch location known from map (north) but not visited; red science needs copper plates.

CURRENT SITUATION at cutoff: Engineer beside fuelled furnace in iron field, ~6 iron ore mined and carried, furnace recipe set to Iron plate but idle awaiting input; objective ~10/50 plates. Next logical step is opening the furnace GUI and ctrl+clicking carried ore in, then repeat mine→smelt→collect cycles.
